outcome: Perinatal outcomes (gestational age at delivery, mode of delivery, birth weight, neonatal intensive care unit admission)
cohort: Pregnant women with vasa previa treated at a single center between 2006 and 2019
finding: Fetoscopic laser ablation for type II vasa previa was technically successful in all cases and resulted in favorable outcomes, including a high rate of vaginal delivery and no neonatal intensive care unit admissions.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery occurred in 5 out of 10 cases that underwent laser ablation.
birth_weight: 2,965 ± 596 g (for singleton pregnancies after protocol change)
